@@ -39,3 +48,146 @@ jobs:
         run: bash scripts/interactions/test-schema.sh
       - name: Full migration, policy, moderation, compatibility, privacy and concurrency properties
         run: bash scripts/interactions/test-database.sh
+
+  native-ios-e2e:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.native_ios_run != ''
+    runs-on: macos-15
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read
+    env:
+      LANG: en_US.UTF-8
+      LC_ALL: en_US.UTF-8
+      STACK_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.stack-root-ios
+      HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: '1'
+      HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: '1'
+    steps:
+      - name: Validate immutable application identity
+        env:
+          APPLICATION_SHA: ${{ inputs.application_sha }}
+          MOBILE_RUN: ${{ inputs.native_ios_run }}
+        run: |
+          [[ "$APPLICATION_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
+          [[ "$MOBILE_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
+          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: submodule.tdf-mobile.update
+          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: checkout
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.application_sha }}
+          submodules: recursive
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@b6effb05e454b25005698d916606bdc6ffcbf961 # v5
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: '21'
+      - name: Verify and download the original simulator artifact
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          MOBILE_RUN: ${{ inputs.native_ios_run }}
+        run: |
+          gh api "repos/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/actions/runs/$MOBILE_RUN" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mobile-run.json"
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json, os, pathlib, subprocess
+          run=json.loads((pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'mobile-run.json').read_text())
+          assert run['conclusion']=='success'
+          assert run['path']=='.github/workflows/interaction-simulator.yml'
+          source=run['head_sha']
+          assert len(source)==40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in source)
+          subprocess.run(['git','-C','tdf-mobile','fetch','--no-tags','--depth=1','origin',source],check=True)
+          def tree(ref):
+              return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','tdf-mobile','rev-parse',ref+'^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
+          assert tree(source)==tree('HEAD'), 'Simulator source tree differs from the pinned mobile source'
+          print('Verified exact native source tree:',tree(source))
+          PY
+          gh run download "$MOBILE_RUN" --repo diegueins680/TDF-mobile --pattern 'interaction-simulator-*' --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-simulator"
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json, os, pathlib, subprocess
+          root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
+          run=json.loads((root/'mobile-run.json').read_text())
+          receipts=list((root/'interaction-simulator').rglob('tdf-interaction-source.txt'))
+          archives=list((root/'interaction-simulator').rglob('tdf-interaction-simulator.tgz'))
+          assert len(receipts)==len(archives)==1
+          # PR builds record GitHub's tested merge commit, while run metadata
+          # identifies the branch head. Both must have the exact pinned tree.
+          source=receipts[0].read_text().strip()
+          assert len(source)==40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in source)
+          subprocess.run(['git','-C','tdf-mobile','fetch','--no-tags','--depth=1','origin',source],check=True)
+          def tree(ref):
+              return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','tdf-mobile','rev-parse',ref+'^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
+          assert tree(source)==tree('HEAD'), 'Artifact receipt source differs from the pinned native tree'
+          PY
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-app"
+          tar -xzf "$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-simulator" -name tdf-interaction-simulator.tgz -print -quit)" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-app"
+          codesign --verify --deep --strict "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-app/TDFRecords.app"
+          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-app/TDFRecords.app/main.jsbundle"
+      - name: Install PostgreSQL 17 and build the pinned vector extension
+        run: |
+          brew install postgresql@17 pkg-config
+          interaction_pg="$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)"
+          echo "$interaction_pg/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          git init "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector"
+          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector" remote add origin https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector.git
+          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector" fetch --depth=1 origin 778dacf20c07caf904557a88705142631818d8cb
+          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
+          make -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector" PG_CONFIG="$interaction_pg/bin/pg_config" OPTFLAGS=''
+          make -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pgvector" PG_CONFIG="$interaction_pg/bin/pg_config" install
+          "$interaction_pg/bin/initdb" -D "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-postgres" -A trust -U postgres
+          "$interaction_pg/bin/pg_ctl" -D "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-postgres" -l "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-postgres.log" -o '-h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432' -w start
+      - name: Restore macOS Stack dependencies
+        uses: actions/cache@v6
+        with:
+          path: ${{ env.STACK_ROOT }}
+          key: interaction-mac-stack-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('tdf-hq/stack.yaml', 'tdf-hq/stack.yaml.lock', 'tdf-hq/tdf-hq.cabal') }}
+      - uses: haskell-actions/setup@7fd2bb5ca789761088fbc831406b2910e47e56f1 # v2
+        with:
+          ghc-version: '9.10.3'
+          stack-version: '3.11.1'
+          enable-stack: true
+          stack-no-global: true
+          stack-setup-ghc: true
+          cabal-update: false
+      - name: Build the exact application backend with Stack
+        working-directory: tdf-hq
+        run: |
+          stack --no-terminal build tdf-hq:exe:tdf-hq-exe --copy-bins --local-bin-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-backend" --extra-include-dirs="$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/include" --extra-lib-dirs="$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/lib"
+      - name: Install the checksum-pinned Maestro runtime
+        run: |
+          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error https://github.com/mobile-dev-inc/Maestro/releases/download/cli-2.5.1/maestro.zip -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/maestro.zip"
+          printf '%s  %s\n' '2d924bfd37cccabca438a727213648cbfe4f8bb711559ec8e9d199dc09a5ce52' "$RUNNER_TEMP/maestro.zip" | shasum -a 256 --check
+          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/maestro.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/maestro-cli"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/maestro-cli/maestro/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Boot a dedicated simulator and install the unchanged artifact
+        run: |
+          interaction_runtime=$(xcrun simctl list runtimes available --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=[r for r in json.load(sys.stdin)["runtimes"] if r.get("isAvailable") and r["name"].startswith("iOS 18")]; assert r,"No iOS 18 runtime"; print(sorted(r,key=lambda v:tuple(map(int,v["version"].split("."))))[-1]["identifier"])')
+          interaction_device=$(xcrun simctl create TDFInteractionCI com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimDeviceType.iPhone-16 "$interaction_runtime")
+          echo "TDF_INTERACTION_NATIVE_DEVICE=$interaction_device" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          xcrun simctl boot "$interaction_device"
+          xcrun simctl bootstatus "$interaction_device" -b
+          xcrun simctl install "$interaction_device" "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-app/TDFRecords.app"
+      - name: Run the real HTTP and installed iOS discussion journeys
+        env:
+          PGHOST: 127.0.0.1
+          PGUSER: postgres
+          PGPASSWORD: unused-local-test-value
+          TDF_INTERACTION_SERVER_BIN: ${{ runner.temp }}/interaction-backend/tdf-hq-exe
+          TDF_INTERACTION_SERVER_PORT: '18128'
+        run: bash scripts/interactions/test-http.sh
+      - name: Stop the owned test services
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          if test -n "${TDF_INTERACTION_NATIVE_DEVICE:-}"; then xcrun simctl shutdown "$TDF_INTERACTION_NATIVE_DEVICE" || true; fi
+          if test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-postgres/postmaster.pid"; then "$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/bin/pg_ctl" -D "$RUNNER_TEMP/interaction-postgres" -m fast -w stop; fi
+      - name: Retain only synthetic native screenshots
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
+        with:
+          name: interaction-ios-evidence-${{ inputs.application_sha }}
+          path: /tmp/tdf-interaction-native-*.png
+          if-no-files-found: ignore
+          retention-days: 7

 The aggregate quality check includes this job when explicitly selected.
+
+The `Universal interaction verification` workflow also supports an explicit
+hosted iOS run. Supply `native_ios_run` with a successful mobile simulator-build
+run and `application_sha` with the full immutable root commit to qualify. The
+macOS runner checks out that exact commit, verifies that the artifact's source
+tree equals its pinned mobile tree, verifies the original app signature, builds
+the backend with the project's Stack resolver, and starts an isolated PostgreSQL
+17 database. It runs the same complete HTTP/native runner on a dedicated iOS 18
+simulator. No rebundling, resigning, production credentials or live services are
+used. Only synthetic screenshots are retained; fixture credentials and database
+contents remain on the disposable runner. This optional job is not selected by
+ordinary pull requests, and must pass explicitly before claiming iOS qualification.

@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+# Interaction release evidence — 30 September 2026
+
+The feature is not merged, deployed or activated. This document supersedes
+earlier release-status summaries, without reassigning historical test results to
+new artifacts.
+
+## Qualified application revision
+
+- Root application/schema revision: `0a5653dc349f9faaf237a521aa50016a2fb1d6d9`.
+  [CI 36525453887](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36525453887)
+  passed, including actual backend HTTP regressions, web journeys, migrations,
+  contracts and property checks. The default optional Android job was skipped;
+  installed Android has separate evidence below. All 37 known review threads are
+  resolved. PR 470 received independent approval on this exact commit on
+  30 September; GitHub reports APPROVED/CLEAN.
+- [Image build 36525461076](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36525461076)
+  passed. Registry inspection matched the CI index digest
+  `sha256:3e7f5396d9ffa91347578f614ff8356a47bb47e77d721470efff07211fd851d1`.
+  This is a pre-merge candidate, not a deployed release.
+- The manifest contains 155 migrations. A fresh PostgreSQL 17 database passed
+  all seven SQL suites and nine concurrency properties. The encrypted production
+  restore accepted the manifest and retains all 30 notifications while paused.
+  No live schema was changed. A fresh backup is required at actual cutover.
+- The 10,000-comment/2,000-reactor rehearsal measured 18.582 ms for summary,
+  6.782 ms for roots, 4.865 ms for replies and 4.824 ms for exact context.
+  Synthetic changes were rolled back; these measurements are not production SLOs.
+
+## Native artifact boundary
+
+Root pins `3ee82fe403b358b405568ed5164cf7798eb45e0b`. Native PR 124 merged as
+`12a472ecb68e9a9c0bcba81baf0fafa551d59253`. Both have tree
+`474467f45df50a4cfd6690d8d84fecee8903ef13`, also matching the simulator artifact's
+source `fd6cdcd22915384ab8dbbf9c5a128b40419505fc`.
+
+- [Installed Android 36520750030](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36520750030)
+  passed reaction, comment, reply notification/deep link, edit, parent deletion
+  and retained-reply assertions. The first emulator attempt was obstructed by a
+  Pixel Launcher ANR dialog; the fresh-emulator retry passed.
+- Native unit/rendered qualification passed 553 tests, type checking and lint.
+  This does not substitute for installed-device or screen-reader tests.
+- The latest iOS artifact has verified source provenance and strict signature,
+  but its installed journey is **not qualified**. Repeated local runs exhausted
+  disk space during app reset/reinstallation and diagnostic creation. Earlier
+  successful iOS journeys apply only to their earlier artifacts. On 30 September,
+  starting the dedicated simulator reduced available space to about 1 GB; it was
+  stopped before another test attempt. Free capacity subsequently fell below
+  500 MB again, and Chrome displayed its own low-storage warning.
+- Signed Android 22 and iOS 29 passed independent receipt/hash, signature,
+  production API, runtime and associated-domain configuration checks. Android 22
+  remains a saved, held, unpublished Play draft; Alpha 17 remains active. iOS 29
+  has not been uploaded. App Store Connect sign-in was verified on 30 September;
+  its TestFlight list shows build 25 as the newest listed build. Candidate 29
+  is absent. The collapsed upload-history section has not been inspected.
+- Physical VoiceOver/TalkBack and installed HTTPS association behavior remain
+  unverified. Static signing/configuration checks do not establish those results.
+
+## Deployment gates
+
+Production health was checked again on 30 September and reports database/status
+OK. The last inspected live schema remains the 115-entry baseline. Trader and its
+shared Fly database remain untouched. Neither Cloudflare production automation
+nor association variables have been changed for this release.
+
+Follow the [rollout runbook](rollout.md): preserve the approval, pause only automatic
+Cloudflare production deployments, protected merge commit preserving migration
+ancestry, exact merged image, fresh encrypted backup and rehearsal, schema/backend
+deployment, client and association qualification, then guarded activation and live
+canaries. Do not bypass review or publish held native builds before their gates.
